assumptions.memory_ports: R*W coherent single-read/single-write replicas; broadcast writes, conflict/replay for multiwrite; arbitration charged in logic; concurrency not validated
assumptions.precision_implementation: shared FP32 datapath envelope plus conversion/control allowance for each non-FP32 mode; no precision-width area discount or throughput claim

coupling: one row/group; shared fields equal the same global one-hot values; all contributions add
objective_scope: cost constraints only; performance/program constraints must be attached separately
